message: No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local filesystem paths only; no remote fetching, checksum verification, or authentication is performed.

No detected label flipping detection: The code loads and tensorizes labels (gold_starts, gold_ends, gold_mention_cluster_map) without any validation of label distributions, expected value ranges, or noise-detection tools.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation pipeline reads JSON lines and tensorizes them directly with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs.

No detected model integrity verification: The load_model_checkpoint call and AutoTokenizer usage in tensorize.py have no hash checks, signature verification, pinned revisions, or controlled-source enforcement visible in the provided code.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard AdamW/Adam optimizers with no DP-SGD, Opacus, or TensorFlow Privacy integration.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress-test routines are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected input sanitization: The inference path loads pre-tensorized data from cache or files without any shape/range validation or schema checks on incoming inputs before passing them to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks on model outputs are visible in the inference-related code paths shown.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a coreference resolution model, not an LLM text-in/text-out system, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
